'''Linda Jean Tacconi–Garman''' (born August 5, 1959) is a senior scientist at the [[Max Planck Institute for Extraterrestrial Physics]].

==Career==
Tacconi was born on August 5, 1959.<ref>{{cite web |title=Tacconi, Linda, 1959- |url=https://id.loc.gov/authorities/names/n2001000076.html |website=id.loc.gov |access-date=January 4, 2021}}</ref> She earned her [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] from the [[University of Massachusetts Amherst]] in 1988 and published her thesis titled "The Distribution of the Interstellar Medium in the SCD Galaxy NGC 6946 and in a Sample of Dwarf Irregular Galaxies."<ref>{{cite web |title=Astronomy Alumni & PhD Theses |url=https://www.astro.umass.edu/academics/grad/thesis |website=astro.umass.edu |access-date=January 4, 2021}}</ref> Upon completing her PhD, Tacconi began working at the Netherlands Foundation for Research in Astronomy ([[ASTRON]]) before leaving to work with the [[Max Planck Institute for Extraterrestrial Physics]] (MPE) in 1991.<ref name = "Yale">{{cite web |title=Linda Tacconi |url=https://gruber.yale.edu/linda-tacconi |website=gruber.yale.edu |access-date=January 4, 2021}}</ref> During her time at MPE, she received the Lancelot Berkeley Prize "in recognition of her contributions to the field, and in particular the recent paper on 'High molecular gas fractions in normal massive star-forming galaxies in the young Universe."<ref>{{cite web |title=Linda Tacconi receives Lancelot Berkeley Prize |url=https://www.mpe.mpg.de/494095/News_20120110 |website=mpe.mpg.de |access-date=January 4, 2021 |date=January 10, 2012}}</ref>

During the [[COVID-19 pandemic]], Tacconi was elected a foreign member of the [[Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences]] for her "extraordinary research in the field of millimeter astronomy and her commitment to European astronomy."<ref>{{cite web |title=Linda Tacconi zum ausländischen Mitglied der Königlich-Schwedischen Akademie der Wissenschaften gewählt |url=https://www.mpe.mpg.de/7503358/news20200924 |website=mpe.mpg.de |access-date=January 4, 2021 |language=German |date=September 24, 2020}}</ref> She was also elected the president of the European Southern Observatory Council's main governing body.<ref>{{cite web |title=Linda Tacconi Elected as Next ESO Council President |url=https://www.eso.org/public/announcements/ann20035/ |website=eso.org |access-date=January 4, 2021 |date=December 8, 2020}}</ref>
